# Jamloom

> Jamloom is an AI music app on the web and iPhone. Music DNA turns your favorite artists and songs into an original song with AI vocals; Improvise turns a recorded sound into a short arrangement. Jamloom also offers a free in-browser DJ studio, DJ lessons and a singing course.

## Make songs
- [Music DNA](https://www.jamloom.com/music-dna): pick favorite artists or songs (or a YouTube playlist), press Generate once, and get an original song of about two minutes with AI vocals, in your chosen language. You can close the page; Jamloom emails you when the song is ready.
- [Improvise](https://www.jamloom.com/improvise): record or import a sound (a hum, a beat, a sentence) and get a 30–45 second arrangement around it.
- [Community](https://www.jamloom.com/community): listen to songs people chose to share. Songs are private unless their creator makes them public.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://www.jamloom.com/pricing): a Music DNA song costs 20 credits and an Improvise arrangement 10 credits; private songs cost 25% more. 150 credits cost $20 (one time), or the Creator plan gives 300 credits for $35 a month. Credits never expire, and songs that fail return their credits. New accounts can claim a free first song while places last.

## Learn and mix
- [DJ Studio](https://www.jamloom.com/dj-studio): two decks in the browser, no equipment needed, free.
- [DJ Academy](https://www.jamloom.com/academy): learn to DJ on a laptop, starting with a free first lesson.
- [Singing Academy](https://www.jamloom.com/singing-academy): sing originals and familiar melodies with pitch feedback.
- [Local Remixes](https://www.jamloom.com/local-remixes): turn a short recording into instrumental remixes in your browser, free; audio stays on your device.
- [Live DJ](https://www.jamloom.com/live-dj): mix audio playing in a supported browser tab; capture from Mac apps is in private preview.
